variables.name: component/banner/background/neutral-default
variables.comment: Neutral (default) variant background. Same semantic ref across all modes — layer-01 resolves per brand/mode.

variables.name: component/banner/text/neutral-default
variables.comment: Neutral variant text. All → color/text/strong today. Per-variant for future brand flexibility.

variables.name: component/banner/text/information-default
variables.comment: Information variant text. Same as neutral today. Future brands may use variant-specific text color.

variables.name: component/banner/text/error-default
variables.comment: Error variant text. Same as neutral today. Future brands may use e.g. red text for error banners.

variables.name: component/banner/icon/neutral-default
variables.comment: Neutral (default) variant prefix icon. Lite: --banner-prefix-default → color/foreground/icon/strong.

variables.name: component/banner/icon/information-default
variables.comment: Information variant prefix icon. Lite: --banner-prefix-info → color/system/info/default.

variables.name: component/banner/icon/error-default
variables.comment: Error variant prefix icon. Lite: --banner-prefix-error → color/system/danger/default.

variables.name: component/banner/icon/dismiss-default
variables.comment: Close (X) icon. Named 'dismiss' for consistency with Modal. Lite: --banner-close-icon → color/foreground/icon/strong.
